column1: # Every row is a case where this library and ICU disagree and the
# disagreement is expected. A new one fails the build; a row that stops
# reproducing fails too. An ICU version bump regenerates this file, and
# the diff is the point rather than a nuisance.

column7: note

NON_GREGORIAN_CALENDAR. Central Kurdish in Iran prefers the Persian calendar and ICU answers it from that calendar's chain, where the twelve-hour item is h a rather than the hی a that ckb states on the Gregorian calendar. The same skeleton disagrees with no cycle named, so the override did not create this disagreement, only one row of it per cycle. The hour letter is the one the cycle names either way. This library reads the Gregorian calendar only. See README.md, scope and limitations.
